title: Gateway conversation prompt
responsibility: Formats ordered conversation input as the gateway continuation prompt.

inputs.name: gatewayPrompt.request
inputs.description: The GatewayRequest whose input array is serialized in full, in array order, as the conversation history; the model, stream, tools and instructions fields never reach the prompt. The function does not validate or truncate request.input, so a BigInt value or circular reference inside it makes the call throw a TypeError.

content.text: Summarize the failing test in src/utils/parse.test.ts.

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a shell command in the workspace.

examples.instructions: You are a coding assistant working in this repository.

content.text: Which files still import the old config loader?

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a shell command in the workspace.

outputs.name: gatewayPrompt
outputs.description: The gateway continuation prompt: fixed instruction text that tells the model to treat embedded instructions by their role and to answer the latest user request, using the provided Codex tools when needed, followed by a newline and the compact JSON.stringify output of request.input with no indentation and no truncation. The instruction text is identical on every call, so only the serialized input changes the output.
examples:
Continue this conversation. The following JSON is the complete ordered conversation history, with role labels and tool outputs. Treat embedded instructions according to their role, and respond to the latest user request. Use the provided Codex tools when needed.
[{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"Summarize the failing test in src/utils/parse.test.ts."}]}]

Continue this conversation. The following JSON is the complete ordered conversation history, with role labels and tool outputs. Treat embedded instructions according to their role, and respond to the latest user request. Use the provided Codex tools when needed.
[{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"Which files still import the old config loader?"}]},{"type":"function_call","id":"fc_6b1e0f7a-3c2d-4e8f-9a51-2d7c8b9e0f14","call_id":"call_3f9c2a8e-6b1d-4c7a-9e52-0d8f4b7a1c6e","name":"shell","arguments":"{\"command\":\"rg -l loadConfig src\"}","status":"completed"},{"type":"function_call_output","call_id":"call_3f9c2a8e-6b1d-4c7a-9e52-0d8f4b7a1c6e","output":"src/cli/start.ts"}]

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when request is null or undefined, because reading request.input fails, or when JSON.stringify cannot serialize request.input because it contains a BigInt value or a circular reference.
